Light offshore breeze from 17:00, 13 km/h: flat at the dock.
Changeable: showers 10:00–11:00 and 15:00–16:00 and from 17:00, dry in between.

headline: Fog and glass, then Bise
subline: Best until 09:00. Bise chop from 14:00, rain from 15:00.

points.text: Fog 09:00–10:00 and 11:00–13:00, visibility down to 1.3 km.
Bise (onshore) from 14:00, 5–9 km/h: a bit of chop. Too much for clean pumping, too little for winging.
Dead flat until 14:00: wind under 5 km/h.

headline: Flat water between the showers
subline: Best window 12:00–15:00 while it's dry; showers return from 15:00.

points.text: Flat water until 15:00 and from 16:00: 3–10 km/h, no chop at the dock.
Light offshore breeze 15:00–16:00, 15 km/h: flat at the dock.
Changeable: showers 08:00–12:00 and from 15:00, dry in between.

headline: Patchy fog, then a flat window
subline: Best window 12:00–14:00, before Bise chop and showers from 14:00.

points.text: Bise (onshore) from 14:00, 8 km/h: a bit of chop. Too much for clean pumping, too little for winging.
Dead flat until 14:00 and from 17:00: wind under 5 km/h.
Changeable: showers 10:00–12:00 and from 14:00, dry in between.
